newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SALOMON UPS BP ESTIMATES, PRICE.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SALOMON UPS BP ESTIMATES, PRICE.

text.p: Salomon Brothers raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates for British Petroleum Co Plc and lifted its 12-month target price to 950p from 850p, the investment bank said.
EPS estimates for 1997 were revised up to 49.3 pence from 47.8 pence, and for 1998 to 52.7 pence from 50.6, analysts at Salomon said in a report.
Its 12-month price target was raised to 950p, or $93 for its ADRs, from 850p or $83, it said.

"BP's excellent Q2 results underline our positive view on the stock," the analysts said. "Targets for profit improvement through cost reduction and volume growth are being exceeded, and long-term prospects remain good."
At 1010 GMT, BP shares were off 2-1/2p at 911p.
